summary: The candidate misses the printed paragraph after Задача 1.2.Б („Приемете, че атмосферното налягане p0 = const …“) that introduces p0, g and ρ for the whole problem — a critical omission. Otherwise the statements, points and solutions match the pages well; the two figure boxes look acceptable though crop #1 extends into the text column.

defects.description: The print, immediately after подусловие Б of Задача 1.2, contains the paragraph „Приемете, че атмосферното налягане p0 = const и в двата случая е известно. Температурното разширение на водата се пренебрегва. Земното ускорение е g, плътността на водата е ρ.“ The candidate drops it entirely, so p0, g and ρ used in the statements and solution are undefined for the reader.
defects.suggestedFix: Приемете, че атмосферното налягане $p_0 = \mathrm{const}$ и в двата случая е известно. Температурното разширение на водата се пренебрегва. Земното ускорение е $g$, плътността на водата е $\rho$.

defects.description: Box [550,240,950,480] extends well to the left of the cylinders drawing (which starts around x≈680 permille); the left strip 550–680 overlaps the end of the body-text column of Задача 1.1 and risks swallowing printed text in the crop.
The page header reads „ПРОЛЕТНО НАЦИОНАЛНО СЪСТЕЗАНИЕ ПО ФИЗИКА“ — a national olympiad round, not a „test“; roundType „test“ does not fit the paper.

The print shows the first fall time possibly as plain „t“ while the candidate writes t₁; at scan resolution the subscript is barely legible and the official solutions use t₁ and t₂, so the candidate's reading is consistent with the solutions.
Top-level statements of problems 1 and 3 are placeholder text („Задача с подчасти.“) not present in the print; harmless since all printed content is in the parts, but it is invented wording.
